resources.string: In Accessibility Settings, open Downloaded apps or Installed services, select Screenly, and turn on Use Screenly. Return here to check the status.

After enabling the service, open Android Settings. Tap the floating Screenly bubble, then Guide Me, and enter a goal such as How do I change my font size? Manually tap the highlighted control; Screenly will check the next screen. Open Guide Me to recheck, stop, confirm completion, or use the manual picker. Drag the bubble to move it. Debug builds print observations to Logcat.
Screen observations stay in memory and debug Logcat. Password and sensitive nodes are skipped; editable values are omitted. Screenly does not save screen contents, use the network, or tap for you.

Inspects accessible interface elements in other apps and displays a floating assistant for manual highlighting. Debug observations appear in Logcat. Password and sensitive nodes are skipped, and editable values are omitted. No screen contents are saved or sent over the network; Screenly does not tap for you.
Screenly assistant. Tap to open actions; drag to move.
On-device AI chat is not available in this prototype yet. Use Guide Me to manually select and highlight controls.
AI screen explanations are not implemented yet. Guide Me can highlight a selected control without tapping it for you.
No enabled clickable elements are available on this screen. Close the picker and navigate to another screen.
The screen changed. Open the picker again to select a current element.
What would you like to do?
How do I change my font size?
Waiting for an accessible screen. Open the relevant application.
Checking this screen on your device…
I couldn\'t identify the correct button on this screen. Try opening the relevant menu, then ask me again.
Local AI is unavailable, and I couldn\'t verify a next step. Open the relevant menu or use the manual picker.
AI unavailable; verified step. Tap the “%1$s” control or label.
You confirmed that your goal is complete.
